1) You send sample prompts + expected stop sequences (we use those in the streaming harness).
2) We run an initial model-fit eval (benchmarks + qualitative checks) and share results in 3 business days.
3) If model fit looks good, schedule a 1-week sandbox with streaming enabled and synthetic traffic that mirrors your volume.

I'll loop Jordan (solutions engineering) and Rachel (CS) into the next message to scope the sandbox and technical plan.

Hi Alex —

Quick technical notes from the streaming engineering side: 

- Partial-output coherence: most visible when chunk boundaries cut in the middle of predicted tokens. We mitigate by using smaller chunk sizes with overlap for the last N tokens (we recommend 16-token overlap for vicuna-13b class models). Overlap increases token cost slightly but reduces mid-sentence truncation.
- Stop sequences: ensure the client applies both server-side and client-side enforcement. Server-side: configure the model-level stop_sequences list (we can provision per-customer defaults). Client-side: always apply a final post-process check to trim trailing incomplete tokens.
- KV cache warmup: warm a shared cache on session start for common system prompts. For your workload, pre-warming on session init reduced first-response latency by ~120–180ms in our similar tests.
- Latency targets: With vicuna-13b-q4f serving on our Dedicated pools, achievable p95 is ~350–550ms for the token sizes you reported, p99 ~700–900ms under the synthetic load we ran. For oss-7b-pt p95 is ~220–350ms. These will vary by exact sequence length and concurrency.

Streaming test plan: https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming-test-plan#acme — we'll run a 48-hour smoke + 5-day sandbox with synthetic concurrency mirroring 150 active users. If you can provide an API key allowlist (or let us create sandbox creds), we'll schedule the run next week.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Note: for deep debugging we may need a sample 1:1 recording of a streaming session (client-side logs), see the linked doc for examples.
